name: World Monitor v2 Global Intelligence Dashboard
description: Real-time news, conflict and market signals on one AI-powered map.

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck use it.

WM_APP_UPSTREAM.description: Private host:port of the worldmonitor service (nginx).

WM_UI_USERNAME.description: Login name for the dashboard (HTTP basic auth). Letters, digits and . _ @ - only.

WM_UI_PASSWORD.description: Dashboard password, generated at deploy (at least 12 characters). Change it here and redeploy the gateway.

WM_PUBLIC_DASHBOARD.description: true removes the login. Only do this if you accept that anyone with the URL can trigger LLM briefs and keyed API calls on your keys.

PORT.description: nginx port inside the image (hardcoded upstream). Railway health-checks PORT, so keep 8080.

VITE_VARIANT.description: Dashboard variant baked in at build time: full, tech, finance, commodity, happy or energy. Changing it rebuilds the service.

WM_SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs the anonymous browser session (wms_). Required, at least 32 characters; generated at deploy.

WORLDMONITOR_VALID_KEYS.description: Operator API key(s), comma separated, for X-WorldMonitor-Key: REST API, detailed /api/health and the MCP server at /api/mcp. One key is generated at deploy.

WORLDMONITOR_RELAY_KEY.description: Dedicated relay/seeder secret for cache warm-pings and the news digest read (upstream #7437). Generated; ais-relay and the seed services reference it.

WORLDMONITOR_SEED_REFRESH_KEY.description: Secret that lets seed-bundles force the resilience ranking recompute. Generated; seed-bundles references it.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.description: Upstash-compatible REST endpoint of redis-rest over the private network (World Monitor never speaks raw Redis).

WS_RELAY_URL.description: Private URL of ais-relay (vessels, flights, Telegram, OREF, relay-backed market data). The template patches the API sidecar to trust this one private origin.

RELAY_SHARED_SECRET.description: Shared secret sent as x-relay-key to ais-relay. References the value generated on ais-relay.

WM_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.description: Private ranges whose X-Forwarded-For nginx trusts (the gateway), so per-IP limits count real clients. Only private ranges: public clients reach this service through the gateway.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenRouter key (openrouter.ai, free models available): AI briefs and summaries, news threat classification on ais-relay, and the scheduled LLM seed jobs (insights, forecasts, regional briefs). Leave empty to keep server-side LLM calls off.

OLLAMA_API_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of your own Ollama server for AI features without a cloud key, e.g. http://ollama.railway.internal:11434 (a private URL is trusted automatically).

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Optional. Ollama model name (upstream default llama3.1:8b).

LLM_API_URL.description: Optional. Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL (used only together with LLM_API_KEY).

AISSTREAM_API_KEY.description: Optional. aisstream.io key (free signup) for the live ship-tracking layer. The relay opens an outbound websocket; no inbound port is needed.

FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: Optional. Finnhub key (free tier) for equity quotes, symbol search and the earnings calendar. Yahoo-based market data works without it.

ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Alpha Vantage key (free) used as an equity and commodity quote fallback.

FRED_API_KEY.description: Optional. FRED key (free) for US macro series, rates and the economic calendar.

EIA_API_KEY.description: Optional. EIA key (free) for US energy and electricity data.

ACLED_EMAIL.description: Optional. ACLED account email (free for researchers) for conflict and protest events. Without it the conflict index uses GDELT.

ACLED_PASSWORD.description: Optional. ACLED account password (OAuth; tokens refresh automatically).

UCDP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional. UCDP API token for armed-conflict event data.

NASA_FIRMS_API_KEY.description: Optional. NASA FIRMS key (free) for the wildfire / thermal hotspot layer.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Cloudflare Radar token for internet outage data.

AVIATIONSTACK_API.description: Optional. AviationStack key (free tier) for airport delays and flight data.

OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. OpenSky Network API client id (free account) for higher aircraft-tracking rate limits.

OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. OpenSky Network API client secret.

PORT.description: Relay listen port (Node, dual-stack). Railway health-checks PORT at /health.

RELAY_SHARED_SECRET.description: Required. Authenticates every non-public relay route (x-relay-key); the relay refuses to start without it. Generated; worldmonitor and seed-live reference it.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.description: redis-rest over the private network; the relay's in-process seed loops write here.

UPSTASH_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: Lets the relay use the plain-http private redis-rest URL (upstream requires https otherwise and silently disables its seed loops).

API_BASE_URL.description: This install's API, read by the news classify loop and (template patch) the cache warm-pings, instead of the hosted api.worldmonitor.app.

WORLDMONITOR_RELAY_KEY.description: Same relay secret as worldmonitor, sent as X-WorldMonitor-Key on warm-pings and the digest read.

MARKET_YAHOO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS.description: Yahoo market refresh interval in ms (upstream compose default, 15 minutes).

AISSTREAM_API_KEY.description: From worldmonitor (set keys there, then deploy the staged changes).

FINNHUB_API_KEY.description: From worldmonitor (set keys there, then deploy the staged changes).

OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: From worldmonitor (set keys there, then deploy the staged changes).

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Optional. Telegram API id for the OSINT channel feed (needs TELEGRAM_API_HASH and a TELEGRAM_SESSION string, see upstream scripts/telegram).

TELEGRAM_SESSION.description: Optional. Telegram session string. Run one relay replica only: two sessions in parallel get AUTH_KEY_DUPLICATED.

PORT.description: Listen port of the Upstash-compatible REST proxy (dual-stack). Railway health-checks /healthz on it.

SRH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token every caller must send. Generated; the other services reference it as UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.

SRH_CONNECTION_STRING.description: Private connection string of the Redis service (password auth).

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis.

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name.

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network.

REDIS_MAXMEMORY.description: Memory cap with allkeys-lru eviction (upstream compose: 256mb). Raise it with the service memory if INFO shows evicted_keys.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.description: redis-rest over the private network; seeders publish datasets here.

WM_API_BASE_URL.description: Same API base for the forecast seeder's chokepoint warm-ping.
